about: Plain stone-surface textures for StoneRoad's wall stones (rusty-riders, 2026-11-12): Patch asked for walls whose irregularity is built into their geometry, so each stone needs a texture of one continuous stone surface, not a picture of many stones. Z-Image base with the house LoRA v5-3000 at 1.0, seamless, on den-m5 and den-nimo. The first round (raw-m5, raw-nimo: 'the face of one huge dressed stone block') drew separate rounded stones on white, one with a face, and was rejected. The second (surface-m5, surface-nimo: 'a smooth dressed stone surface, one continuous plane') gave continuous surfaces; checks.py passed only seeds 34 and 36. Both were tried on the kit in first person; 36 won (34's parallel diagonal streaks repeat across neighbouring stones like marble). The winner's normal map is make_tileable.normal_map at strength 3, saved RGBA.
